purpose: Align among-taxon and within-taxon environmental structure across the measured GEB v2 inferential trait universe using the same CHELSA predictors and inferential units.

environment.taxon_summary: median across frozen strict spatial observations for each source-assigned taxon

among_taxon_primary_scope.circular_statistic: joint magnitude of standardized sine and cosine taxon-level slopes
among_taxon_primary_scope.permutation_rule: shuffle the taxon-level predictor among the same taxa

multiplicity.families: separate primary and candidate tiers within each among-taxon replication scope

claim_boundary: Among-taxon taxon-label permutation is not phylogenetic correction.
Cross-sectional within-taxon association is not demonstrated plasticity or adaptation.
Cross-scale concordance is not evidence of a shared causal mechanism.
Candidate image-derived endpoints remain exploratory until botanical reference validation.
